Therefore, any potentially dangerous operations inside it are irrelevant for this safety gate. The use of variable indirection and array indexing for source and checksum definitions is standard in AUR packages and does not introduce risk during parsing. No data exfiltration, code execution, or side-effecting operations occur when sourcing this file.

Thus, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe, as it cannot trigger malicious behavior at parse time.
</details>
